items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I knew about... the same family that lived right next door to them... who was the Sealy family

ctx.x: So I'm laying up in bed, and it finally dawned on me, why don't you go to the phone company and look in the Montreal phone book and see if you can find that they are still listed. So I look in the listings, and I didn't see a Jones in there, so I thought about this family that lived
next door, who was the Sealy family. So I look in the phone book, and there it was and the address was right next door -- one address was 769 and the other 767, so I knew I was on the right track.
